primary_frozen_thresholds.rationale: Frozen at 2.00 percentage points (0.0200). On a ~92-word subgroup, 1 word alteration equals 1.09%, which represents the discrete granularity limit. A practically meaningful regression must exceed 1 word (>= 2 words = 2.17% ~ 2.00%) and exceed calibration sampling variability. Selected strictly on calibration.csv without test-set exposure.
